# Loop reversal with no dependence: for i := len(s) - 1; i >= 0; i-- is
# accepted, because the body only touches each slice at index i, so
# direction cannot change the result. The rewritten loop always runs
# forward.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func FillFromReverse(a, b []float32) {
	for i := len(a) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		a[i] = b[i] + 1
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func FillFromReverse(a, b []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(1)
	if _loopvecOverlap(a, b, 0, len(a), 0, len(b)) {
		for i := len(a) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			a[i] = b[i] + 1
		}
	} else {
		if len(a) > 0 {
			_ = b[len(a)-1]
			{
				_w1 := a[:len(a):len(a)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := b[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2)
					_v1.Add(_vcFloat32s0).Store(_c1)
					_v2 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v2.Add(_vcFloat32s0).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v3.Add(_vcFloat32s0).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v4.Add(_vcFloat32s0).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v5 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v5.Add(_vcFloat32s0).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v6, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v6.Add(_vcFloat32s0).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi int) bool {
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	return aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size < bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size && bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size < aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	a := make([]float32, 5)
	b := []float32{1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5, 5.5}
	test.FillFromReverse(a, b)
	fmt.Println(a)
}
-- testmain/output --
[2.5 3.5 4.5 5.5 6.5]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func FillFromReverse(a, b []float32) {
	for i := len(a) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		a[i] = b[i] + 1
	}
}
